akreditiv.title: Letter of Credit
akreditiv.p1: A documentary letter of credit (L/C) is our written obligation (issued on behalf of the buyer in favor of the seller) to pay a certain amount to the seller of goods upon presentation of documents complying with the terms of the letter of credit.
akreditiv.p2: Letters of credit are issued in accordance with the uniform rules developed by the International Chamber of Commerce (depending on the terms and features of the commercial transaction).
akreditiv.conditionsTitle: Main conditions for issuing a letter of credit:
akreditiv.cond1: It is necessary to have a letter of credit coverage in your account, which is fixed in your special coverage account.
akreditiv.cond2: The mode of your special coverage account, the interest rate calculated on the account balance, and other conditions are established by contract.
akreditiv.cond3: In case of partial or complete absence of your own funds in your account, we consider the possibility of providing you with a credit line.
akreditiv.p3: For additional information and advice on the issuance of documentary letters of credit, you can contact our Head Office, International and Foreign Exchange Operations Department.
akreditiv.noteText: – In addition to the fees established by these rates and tariffs, we charge the amount of our actual expenses incurred.
